{{Quote|I've heard some bad rumors recently about ... something dangerous to Coronet. An informant of mine named Ja'inn has more information.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Joth]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:CMTDR" />}}
'''Ja'inn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:CMTDR" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> one of her contacts, the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Moril]], was hired to deliver odd items to a group that he couldn't name. Moril refused to give her any details, displayed a very strange behavior, and even looked terrified. Ja'inn was worried about the Bothan and therefore reported this discussion to [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Joth]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]]. Joth thus sent a spacer to interrogate Moril.<ref name="SWG:CMTDR" /> This led to the discovery of an [[Illegal Lab (Corellia)|illegal lab]] by the CorSec, a lab specialized in [[Bioengineering|bio-engineering]] creatures through dangerous genetic experiments.<ref name="SWG:CMAoD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Coronet Murmurs: Agents of Destruction|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Ja'inn was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CMTDR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Ja'inn was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 28 Notes for April 26, 2006|Publish 28]]," on [[April 26]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref>
